answer: Incident: duplicate submissions cleared a jury of five accounts registered from one host. Fix: juries must span three separate networks, and one upheld challenge revokes the panel's whole payout. Duplicates are caught by replay, not by name, so a renamed copy still fails the second execution. Attack cost rises to three hosting bills, five independent graders, and a lost bond per upheld challenge. A forge on one wharf cannot supply three networks, and a single ember of doubt burns the panel.
